content:
I made a very simple attempt at defining a transducer with the (pretty standard, after looking at some resources) convention of having an input/output symbol pair as transition label:

https://github.com/leanprover/cslib/compare/main...transducer

This doesn't deal with epsilon symbols/empty strings yet, and I've just done the deterministic version. If there's interest in developing this further, I'd be happy to discuss.
Here's an example of how to do an NA-based transducer that handles epsilon characters: cslib#650
